<description>
When a snapshot's network magic doesn't match the node's, `SnapshotMetadata::Unserialize` builds an error message with the names of both networks. The node's name comes from `GetNetworkForMagic(m_network_magic).value()`, which is empty on a custom signet because its magic is derived from the challenge and is not one of the built-in ones. `loadtxoutset` with a snapshot made for another network then fails with `bad_optional_access` instead of the message.

The node side now falls back to "custom signet", the only case where the lookup can be empty.

```
before: Unable to parse metadata: bad_optional_access
after:  Unable to parse metadata: The network of the snapshot (main) does not match the network of this node (custom signet).
```

New unit test `snapshot_metadata_network_mismatch_custom_signet` fails on master with `std::bad_optional_access`. `validation_chainstatemanager_tests` and `feature_assumeutxo.py` pass.
</description>

<commits>
6e8ccff446 node: don't throw bad_optional_access on a snapshot network mismatch

SnapshotMetadata::Unserialize looked up the name of the node's network
with node_network.value(). On a custom signet the magic matches no
built-in network, so loading a snapshot made for another network threw
std::bad_optional_access instead of the intended message.
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/node/utxo_snapshot.h b/src/node/utxo_snapshot.h
index f3a3b8d946..f6056285c4 100644
--- a/src/node/utxo_snapshot.h
+++ b/src/node/utxo_snapshot.h
@@ -93,7 +93,8 @@ public:
             if (metadata_network) {
                 std::string network_string{ChainTypeToString(metadata_network.value())};
                 auto node_network{GetNetworkForMagic(m_network_magic)};
-                std::string node_network_string{ChainTypeToString(node_network.value())};
+                // a custom signet has a magic that matches no built-in network
+                std::string node_network_string{node_network ? ChainTypeToString(*node_network) : "custom signet"};
                 throw std::ios_base::failure(strprintf("The network of the snapshot (%s) does not match the network of this node (%s).", network_string, node_network_string));
             } else {
                 throw std::ios_base::failure("This snapshot has been created for an unrecognized network. This could be a custom signet, a new testnet or possibly caused by data corruption.");
diff --git a/src/test/validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp b/src/test/validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp
index e150f317f4..35c03c9547 100644
--- a/src/test/validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp
+++ b/src/test/validation_chainstatemanager_tests.cpp
@@ -1011,4 +1011,19 @@ BOOST_FIXTURE_TEST_CASE(chainstatemanager_args, BasicTestingSetup)
     BOOST_CHECK(!get_opts({"-prevoutfetchthreads=-1"}));
 }
 
+BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(snapshot_metadata_network_mismatch_custom_signet)
+{
+    // A snapshot made for mainnet, read by a node whose network magic is not
+    // one of the built-in networks (a custom signet).
+    const MessageStartChars main_magic{0xf9, 0xbe, 0xb4, 0xd9};
+    const MessageStartChars custom_magic{0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04};
+
+    DataStream ss;
+    ss << SnapshotMetadata{main_magic, uint256::ZERO, 0};
+
+    SnapshotMetadata metadata{custom_magic};
+    BOOST_CHECK_EXCEPTION(ss >> metadata, std::ios_base::failure,
+                          HasReason("The network of the snapshot (main) does not match the network of this node (custom signet)."));
+}
+
 BOOST_AUTO_TEST_SUITE_END()

</patch>
